components.text:
The Dawn of the New Moon (internally: Sphere Creation Ritual) is a building ritual similar to the Focus of the Ellipsoid, but produces a true sphere. It draws blocks from a linked chest and places them to form a spherical structure around the Master Ritual Stone. Tier 0, costs $(blood)20,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.
